in_english.name: Mukthadir
in_english.meaning: One who is empowered by Allah, symbolizing strength and dominance
in_english.long_meaning: Mukthadir is a name that signifies the power, strength, and dominance granted by Allah. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'ك-ث-د' (k-th-d), which implies 'to be able' or 'to have power', this name reflects the attribute of Allah's omnipotence and control over all things. Historically, it has been used to express the majesty and supremacy of Allah in Islamic tradition. The name Mukthadir is associated with positive personality traits such as leadership, resilience, and determination
